product.name: County of Marin Contract Intake
product.purpose: Collect contract intake information and generate a customized contract-readiness checklist based on the user's answers.
notes: Use radio buttons for discrete choices.
Use Back/Next navigation with a progress indicator.
Information Technology is only part of the workflow for New Contract.
After the Legal step is submitted, show a Thank You transition page, then the customized checklist.
Dollar-value routing logic is intentionally omitted for now.

Why is this an emergency (sudden, unforeseen threat to public health, safety, or welfare) or exigent circumstance (urgent, uncontrollable situation requiring immediate action to prevent significant harm)?
Does this purchase involve any technology that may connect to County systems or handle County data, such as new software, cloud/SaaS, data sharing, integrations, or vendor security concerns?
Does this purchase include any tools or features that use artificial intelligence (AI)?

checklist.intro: Based on the information you provided, the following is a checklist for you as the contract manager to consider before submitting your contract.

sections.title: Procurement

items.text: Complete this sole/single source justification form.
Consult with Procurement to validate it will suffice.
Document where you solicited quotes and be ready to include that information in your submission.
Ask your vendor to register as a vendor.
Continue to check in to validate they have submitted their registration.
Check Vendor Central on MUNIS until you see they are officially registered.

meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement
notes: Procurement Method = Other does not generate a checklist action at this time.

sections.title: Human Resources

items.text: Wait to hear back from HR. They received your input and will follow up with next steps.

meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement
notes: The completed intake is intended to be routed to HR in a future implementation.

sections.title: Information Technology

items.text: Submit a technology request form so that IST can do a security, data, and AI review.
Follow up with IST until you get written approval to proceed—or how to remediate potential issues.
Recommended: PDF any emails or documents that substantiate this to submit later.

meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement

sections.title: Risk

items.text: Reach out to Risk Management and send them a copy of your answers that was sent to this email, calling attention to the ‘Risk’ section.
Follow up with Risk until you get written approval to proceed—or how to remediate potential issues.
Recommended: PDF any emails or documents that substantiate this to submit later.

meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement

sections.title: Insurance

items.text: Reach out to your vendor to ask for a Certificate of Insurance for General Liability.
Reach out to your vendor to ask for an additional insured endorsement with Marin County named.
Obtain or confirm Auto Liability insurance coverage.
Reach out to Risk with an exemption request from auto insurance.
Obtain or confirm Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance.
Reach out to Risk with an exemption request from professional liability.
Get Workers’ Compensation insurance COI (typically the same as the original).
Reach out to Risk for an exemption request from Workers’ Compensation.

append_if_rendered: Recommended: PDF any emails or documents that substantiate this to submit later.
notes: Do not render the Insurance section if no checklist items are generated.
meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement

sections.title: Legal

items.text: Reach out to County Counsel and let them know you are working on a non-standard agreement.
Work with them and the vendor’s Counsel until you have a final contract for submission.
Prepare a contract using the County’s standard contract.

meta_if_rendered: Further Information: FAQ on HR and Procurement
